meaning: While doing something, without much preparation.

word: off the top of my head

meaning: Back to the beginning after a failed attempt.
example: “The file broke, so we are back to square one.”

meaning: Sharing the same understanding or plan.

example: “Let’s make sure we are on the same page.”

meaning: Begin to understand how to do something.
kazakh: Бір нәрсені қалай істеуді меңгере бастау.
example: “You will get the hang of it soon.”

meaning: Adapt to a change without getting stuck.
example: “The schedule changed; just roll with it.”

meaning: Decide what to do as the situation develops.
example: “We can play it by ear after school.”

meaning: Send me a quick digital message.
example: “Ping me when the file is ready.”

meaning: No; it did not work or is not possible.

Openly or strongly; the opposite of low-key.
Very; used as an informal intensifier.
Do something impressively well or become very energetic.

example: “Watch our team pop off in the final round.”

meaning: A playful name for a very memorable moment.
kazakh: Өте есте қаларлық сәтке әзіл атау.

meaning: A reaction when something suddenly reminds you of the past.
kazakh: Бір нәрсе ескі естелікті кенет еске түсіргендегі реакция.

meaning: Something new that already feels memorable and excellent.
kazakh: Жаңа болса да бірден есте қаларлық нәрсе.

meaning: Extremely good; at a high point.
No longer as skilled or successful as before.

meaning: Considered extremely good or among the best.

example: “I am locked in for the last ten minutes.”

meaning: Acting more dramatically or intensely than needed.
I understand; no more explanation is needed.
kazakh: Түсіндім; әрі қарай түсіндірудің қажеті жоқ.
example: “Need help at four? Say no more.”

meaning: I mostly agree, but not completely.
example: “Soft agree; I would change one part.”

meaning: An easy action that gives a useful result quickly.

meaning: Short for session; an informal period of doing an activity.
